name: Chant of Vitu-Ghazi
oracle_text:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
Prevent all damage that would be dealt by creatures this turn. You gain life equal to the damage prevented this way.
blocked_sentences: Prevent all damage that would be dealt by creatures this turn. You gain life equal to the damage prevented this way.

needs.what: a this-turn prevention op keyed to the damage's SOURCE by an effect-side selector (here {types: [Creature]}), matched against the dealer's current characteristics each time damage would be dealt, so creatures that enter or become creatures later in the turn are covered; it must stop combat AND noncombat damage to any recipient (players and permanents), and take the 615.5 `effects` rider with the prevented amount as {binding: amount} so 'You gain life equal to the damage prevented this way' is a gain_life of that binding for the spell's controller
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `prevent_combat_damage` has the right `by` dealer filter and the right clock but only ever touches combat damage and takes no `effects` rider, so a creature's fight, ping or ETB damage would get through and no life would be gained. `prevent_damage_permanent` with `dealt: "by"` over all creatures carries the rider and stops both kinds, but it shields only the objects matched at resolution, so a creature that enters, or a permanent that becomes a creature, later this turn still deals damage. `prevent_damage` (op) shields seats, not by source, and misses damage to creatures. The `prevent_damage` static is continuous on a permanent, not a spell's one-turn effect.
